caseName: What Is Dez Taking From Her Kitchen?
title: Marisol & Dez

questions.text:
Never heard of her. 😤
Kansas City kitchens are a small town. I know every chef, every GM, every rep who walks through my back door.
Where does this woman work?

That's the new place going in across the river. They've been sniffing around every cook in town.
Dez has been my sous for six years. I pulled him off the fry station and trained him myself.
What job did she offer him?
questions.hint: Check his Messages, the older ones too.

questions.text:
My dishwasher. Hardest worker in the building.
She's raising two boys on that job and has never once asked me for a thing.
I heard her tell Tommy her check came up light again.
How much was Bettina's last paycheck short?

Short? I post a full schedule for her every single week. 😳
I cook. I don't do the books and I never have. But I know what I scheduled.
How many hours was she actually paid for on that check?

That's not even close to what she worked.
She closed with me every night that week. I watched her mop out at one in the morning.
Dez keeps his own count of everything, always has.
How many hours did he count for her that week?

That's the number I'd have given you myself.
Twelve-odd hours don't fall off a paycheck by accident. And it isn't only her. My whole line has gone tight-lipped around me.
What else has been coming up short for my crew?
questions.hint: Read the group chats in WhatsApp.

questions.text:
No. Tips are theirs. That is the one rule in my kitchen. 😤
Every night the floor tips out the back, and it goes to the people standing on that line.
How much does Dez figure is missing altogether?

onboarding.text: I'm Marisol Quintero. Tallow & Rye is my kitchen, twelve years now. Four nights ago my sous chef walked off the line mid-service, and I've been short-handed and furious ever since.
onboarding.label: Marisol

onboarding.text: Dez and I built that line together. Six years side by side, burns and all. I taught him my sauces. He taught me to laugh in the middle of a slammed dinner rush.
onboarding.label: Marisol & Desmond

onboarding.text: Desmond Okoro. Dez. Best cook I ever trained. Lately my crew whispers with him and goes quiet when I walk in. New hires keep quitting. Somebody across town is hiring.
onboarding.label: Desmond

onboarding.text: He left his phone in his locker. I cook, I don't snoop, and my husband keeps the books, so I'm asking you. Go through it. Tell me what Dez is taking from me.
onboarding.label: Marisol

480 is my normal. 315 this time. Grill does not get 165 less because it rained.
Mine was 190. I don't know what it's supposed to be, nobody ever told me the number.
It's supposed to be more than 190. Keep that paper.
Probably a slow week on the floor right?
Slow week my ass. We did two private parties.
Don't guess. Count. Everybody keeps their number every week from now on, put it in here.
Yes chef 😂
Don't call me chef. I get enough of that.
Week two. Mine's 295. Normal is 410. Same story.
305 here. Down again.
Dani told me the floor tipped out over a grand on Saturday alone. She counted it into the envelope in front of me.
So over a grand went in on Saturday and it's still this?
Do the math with me. Split over a grand between the five of us. That's not what got handed to me.
I'm not saying anything out loud in the kitchen. Walls have ears in that building.
Good. Keep it in here and nowhere else. Keep counting.
Dez where'd you go? Pass is losing it, tickets are stacking
Rashad says you walked out the back. Tell me that's not true
Your phone's still in the locker. I can see it from here, it keeps lighting up.
Somebody text me when he's reachable. I'm not touching any of this tonight.
Dez call me when you see this. Doesn't matter what time.
Desmond, did you eat? You sounded tired on the phone.
Ate, Mom. Made eggs after I dropped Imani.
Eggs is not a meal. I'm making egusi this weekend, bring Imani.
We'll come. I've got a shift that night but we can come early.
Come at 2. Your father wants to talk to you about the gutter.
Tell Dad I'll bring the ladder and my own tools this time 😂
Imani sent me a voice message singing. Who taught her that song?
That's Burna Boy, Mom. Blame me. She asked for it in the car.
Hmm. At least it's not the bad words.
I skip those parts, I promise.
Did you get the money for the school uniform? Adaeze says it's due soon.
I've got it handled Mom. Thank you. Don't send anything.
I'm your mother, I send what I want.
Ha. Okay. Then send jollof.
That one I will do.
Your Auntie Chidi is asking if you will cook for her anniversary party next month.
How many people?
Forty, maybe fifty. You know how Chidi is.
That's a lot of rice. I'd need a day to prep and a ride for the pans. I can do it if Tobe helps with the driving.
I will tell Tobe. He owes me anyway.
Don't tell him it's a bribe 😂
Are you working tonight? Eat something at work, not just coffee.
On the line till late. Staff meal tonight is pasta, I'll eat.
Good. God bless your hands.
Your father went to the doctor. Everything is fine, just his blood pressure again.
Is he taking the pills? Tell him no salt on the fried plantain.
He doesn't listen to me. Maybe he'll listen to the cook.
I'll call him tonight on my break.
Imani lost another tooth! She showed me on the video call. So proud.
Third one. Tooth fairy is getting expensive.
Give her a dollar and a story.
That's what Dad did to me and I turned out fine.
Church is having the bake sale next week. Can you make your puff puff?
Count me in. How many batches?
Three. I will bring flour, you bring the hands.
Deal. I'll fry at your place so it's fresh.
Don't work too hard this week. You looked thin.
I'm fine Mom. Love you.
Dez! Got your number from Marcus. Still cooking for that fancy place?
Carl! Yeah, still at Tallow & Rye. How've you been man?
Retired from the hotel kitchen two months now. Wife says I'm underfoot.
Ha. Come by the restaurant, I'll feed you.
Might take you up on that. Also I've got a smoker I'm trying to sell, an offset, 250 gallon.
Hmm. I've been wanting one for the cookouts. What are you asking?
Eight hundred. I'll throw in the cover and a chimney starter.
Let me think about it and see where I'd even put it.
Think any more about the smoker?
Landlord says no grills on the balcony. Might keep it in my mom's yard. Let me ask my dad.
Smart. Old man will love it.
Dad says yes. Can I come see it?
Come by anytime in the afternoon. I'm in the garage most days.
On my way with Tobe and his truck. About 30 min.
Coffee's on.
Got it loaded. Thanks Carl, sent it over just now.
Got it. Treat her well. Brisket at 225, don't open the lid.
Yes sir 🔥
First brisket on it. 14 hours. Bark is ridiculous.
That's what I'm talking about. Save me a slice.
Bringing you a pound next time I come.
Happy holiday. You smoking anything?
Ribs and a pork butt, family's over. Wish you were here.
Wife has me at her sister's. Eat one for me.
Chiefs preseason tickets, my buddy has two extra. Want em?
Honestly I can't, I'm on the line most nights. Give them to someone who'll actually go.
Figured. Your loss.
Always is 😂
Can you point me to a good knife sharpener? My old Henckels are dull as spoons.
Hollis Knife Sharpening on the east side. He does Japanese stones. Tell him I sent you.
Will do.
Brought the knives in. He says they're a mess but fixable.
They always are, lol. He'll make them sing.
Wife made me ask: would you cook for our anniversary dinner? At our place. I'll pay you.
Haha, you don't have to pay me. Let's find a date after the next couple weeks, work's crazy.
Take your time. No hurry.
Appreciate it Carl.
Smoked a chuck roast myself. Not as good as yours but I'm learning.
Hi Dez, Blue River Fish here. Walleye came in fresh this morning, 40 lb. Want to add it to this week's drop?
Yeah put me down for 15 lb fillets. Skin on.
Done. Catfish is steady at last week's price. Same 20?
20 lb catfish, yes. Hold the shrimp this week, walk-in's full.
Got it. Driver comes around 6:30 AM, back door like always.
Someone will be there. Tell him not to block the dumpster again 😅
Heads up, shrimp 16/20 is up 90 cents a pound. Holiday week.
Ugh. Give me a number for 10 lb and I'll decide by tomorrow.
$12.40 a pound for 10 lb.
Ok 10 lb. Make sure they're dry-packed this time.
Invoice for last week went to the office email. Showing 2 lb short on catfish, credit on your next order.
Saw it. Appreciate it.
Oysters coming up from the Gulf for the weekend if you want some for a special.
How many are we talking. 6 dozen. Not 12.
6 dozen. Shucking knife not included 😄
Already got mine. Thanks man.
Your drop is set for this week. Same as usual. Have a good one, Dez.
Hello families, a reminder that supply lists for first grade are posted on the school site.
Thanks Ms. Brandt! Do they want the crayons in a pencil box or loose?
Pencil box, labeled. And two glue sticks.
Anyone want to carpool the first week? We're near the Northeast library.
I'd be interested. I'm near there too. Mornings only.
Great, I'll message you.
Meet-the-teacher afternoon is the day before school starts, 3 to 5.
We'll be there!
Count us in.
Reminder: the first-day supply list is in the take-home folder. Please label everything with your child's name.
Does anyone have a spare size 6 uniform polo they're done with? Growth spurt came out of nowhere
I have two that are barely worn. Dropping them at the office Monday.
Is the pickup line moving to the east gate this year? Saw a sign.
Yes, east gate for Room 1 through 3. Cones go up the week before school starts.
Thank you Ms. Brandt 🙏
Is there a school uniform requirement? I'm seeing mixed things.
Navy or white polo, khaki or navy bottoms. Details in the handbook.
Thanks!

msgs.text: Welcome to the building group. I'll use this for notices: water shutoffs, maintenance, trash day changes. Please keep it respectful.
Thank you, Mr. Delgado. Much easier than the notes on the door.
Sounds good. Thanks Mr. Delgado.
Reminder: trash and recycling bins go out the night before pickup. Not the morning of.
Someone's been leaving bags by the dumpster. Raccoons got them again.
I'll put up a sign.
Dale the plumber will be in the building tomorrow for the second floor leak. Water to 2A and 2B may be off from 10 to noon.
Confirming. Two hours max. Bring your buckets, lol.
Do I need to be home?
Not unless you want to. I have the master key.
Anyone know if the dryer on the left in the laundry room is fixed? Ate my quarters this morning.
Dryer on the left is out of order. Technician coming next week.
Thanks. Use the right one, I'll go down after lunch.
Reminder: rent is due on the 1st. Late fee after the 5th. I take check or the portal.
To whoever lit fireworks in the courtyard last night: don't. This is a fire hazard and a warning is all you get.
It was the kids from the corner. I saw them.
Noted. Thank you Mrs. Whitaker.
Does anyone have a spare extension cord? My lamp cord doesn't reach the outlet.
I've got one, I'll leave it on your doorknob tomorrow morning.
You're a blessing.
Parking reminder: guest spots are for guests only. Resident cars with no tag will be towed starting next week.
Do we need new tags? Mine is from last year.
Stop by my office and I'll give you a new one. Bring your registration.
Will do.
FYI the boiler inspection is scheduled. Hot water will be off for part of a day. I'll post the time.
Hot water shutoff is tomorrow, 9 AM to noon. Plan accordingly.
I will take a cold bath, God help me.
Fill the pots tonight Mrs. W 😅
Water is back. Let me know if anyone has low pressure.
Pressure is fine in my unit.
Same in 2A, all good.
Building BBQ in the courtyard next month. I'll supply the grill, volunteers please for food.
I will bring a pie.
I'll handle the meat if you want. Give me a headcount.
Good morning Desmond. The carrier left a box for you with me yesterday. I have it on my kitchen table.
Thank you Mrs. Whitaker! I'll come by when I pick up Imani from camp, around 4.
No rush. Tell Imani I have lemon cookies.
She'll be there before I am 😂
Is that your car with the blinker on? It's been going since last night.
Ugh, trunk was ajar. Going down now. Thanks for the heads up.
Battery will be dead. Just so you know.
Dead as a doornail. Got jumper cables, the guy from 3A is helping.
Good. That young man in 3A is a good one.
Imani left her jump rope in the hallway. I put it by your door.
Thank you ma'am. She'd lose her head if it wasn't attached.
Would you be able to carry my groceries up tomorrow morning? My hip is acting up again.
Of course. I'm up early anyway. 9 okay?
9 is perfect. Bless you.
All upstairs. Left the milk in the fridge like you said.
You are a good son to your mother, whoever she is. Tell her I said so.
Will do 😄 she'll love that.
The fireworks last night scared my cat half to death. Hope Imani slept.
She slept through all of it. I was at work, Ada had her.
Ada is a lovely girl. Nurse hours are worse than yours.
Do you cook with cumin? My daughter sent me a recipe and I don't know where to buy it.
Just saw this. Yes ma'am, any grocery store has it, spice aisle. I'll bring you a jar, I have extra at work.
Oh, you don't have to!
It's a dollar. Leaving it on your doorknob after I drop Imani.
Got the cumin. Made the rice. My husband would have eaten two plates.
Hope it turned out good! Salt it near the end, not at the start.
Mr. Delgado says the hot water will be off tomorrow from 9 to noon. Just warning you.
Thanks, I got his text too. I'll fill the pots tonight for Imani's bath.
Smart man.
Rain's coming. Your windows are open, I can see from the courtyard.
Closing them now, thanks!
Hawthorne Elementary Office: Registration for first grade is confirmed for Imani Okoro. Please bring immunization records and proof of address by the end of June.
Thank you. Will bring them this week. Is the dental form still needed?
Yes, the dental screening form is required for all new first graders.
Ok. Her dentist appointment is already booked. I'll bring it after.
Reminder: the supply list is posted on the school website. Backpacks are provided at orientation.
Got it. Is there an after-school program? I work evenings so mornings are mine, but I sometimes need pickup coverage.
After-care runs until 5:30 PM. Sign-up forms are in the office or online.
Perfect. My sister may pick up sometimes. Her name is Adaeze Okoro. Can I put her on the pickup list?
Yes, please have her bring a photo ID the first time.
Dropped off the immunization form and proof of address this morning. Lady at the front desk said we're all set?
Received. Your file is complete. Thank you Mr. Okoro.
Open house for new families is next week, 5:00 PM in the cafeteria. Teachers will be there to meet families.
I work that evening. Can my sister attend in my place?
Of course. We'll also send an email with Ms. Brandt's welcome letter.
Thanks. Does the school have a bus route for Northeast?
Route 14 stops two blocks from your address. Pickup is 7:25 AM.
Got it, appreciate it. I'll walk her the first week anyway.
Hi Mr. Okoro, this is the Little Sprouts front desk. The summer program schedule for Imani is in her cubby folder. Hours are 7:30 to 5:30.
Got it, thank you. Is there a late fee if I come at 5:45? Some days I get stuck.
Fee is $10 per 15 minutes after 5:30. Just call if you're running behind and we'll work with you.
Appreciate it.
Reminder: tomorrow is pajama day, and bring a water bottle for the splash park trip.
Will do. Does she need a swimsuit too?
Yes, swimsuit and towel in a bag with her name on it.
Thanks 👍
Imani had a small scrape on her knee at the playground. Cleaned and bandaged, she's fine and back to playing.
Thank you for letting me know. Ada's picking her up, I'll tell her.
Sounds good. Ada is on the pickup list, we'll check ID.
She knows the drill.
Monthly invoice is posted in the parent portal. Autopay will draw on the 1st.
Got it. Did the summer fee get added?
Yes, it's a separate line item. Let me know if anything looks off.
Looks right. Thanks.
We're closed tomorrow for the holiday. Regular hours resume the day after.
Thanks, Imani will be with her aunt.
Imani told the whole room she's going to be a first grader and her dad makes the best fried chicken in the world 😊
😂 I'll take it. Tell her chicken's on the menu tonight.
Heads up: the pool trip is cancelled today due to weather. Kids will do indoor games.
Thanks for the heads up.
Would you like to enroll Imani in the after-school program at Hawthorne through us? We run a van pickup.
Interesting. What time does the van get her?
Van leaves Hawthorne at 3:15 and gets here by 3:40. Then regular pickup till 5:30.
I'll talk to my sister, she's been doing most of the afternoons. Can I let you know by the end of the month?
Of course. Spots fill up by mid-August so sooner is better.
Hi, we're going to do the van. Ada said yes. What forms do I need?
Wonderful! Enrollment form and an emergency contact sheet. I'll put them in her cubby.
Perfect. I'll drop them off tomorrow morning.
Forms received, thank you. You're all set for the first day of school.
The last day of summer program is a goodbye picnic at noon. Parents are welcome.
I'll try to make it, I'm on a late shift but can swing by.
Would love to see you. No pressure.
Morning. Need for tomorrow: 30 lb chicken thighs, 20 lb pork shoulder, 12 lb bacon sliced thick.
Got it. Thighs bone-in or boneless?
Bone-in, skin-on.
Confirmed. Delivery by 8 AM at the back door.
Perfect, thanks.
Heads up: short rib is running 30 cents higher this week. Want me to hold the price on your standing order?
Hold what you can. Let me ask Chef about the short rib.
Chef says go ahead on the short rib at the new price, but only 20 lb.
Done. 20 lb short rib added.
Driver is running 20 min late, accident on the highway.
Okay, I'm here till 9:30. Text me when he's close.
He's pulling in now.
Received. Pork shoulder is a little light, ticket says 20 but I'm weighing 18. Can you credit it?
Yes, I'll credit 2 lb on the next invoice. Sorry about that.
No problem. Appreciate it.
Summer special on pork belly: skin-on, 10 lb minimum. Interested?
Maybe. Send me a quote for 15 lb and I'll run it by Chef.
$4.10 a pound, delivered.
Chef's in for 15. Add it to the next delivery.
Added.
We're closed for the holiday. Push that delivery a day.
No problem, moved.
Invoice for last month is in your email. Net 15 as usual.
Got it, forwarding to the office.
Need a rush: 10 lb ground beef, 8 lb beef fat trim for the burger blend. Today if possible.
Can have it on the 1 PM truck.
Works. Thanks.
Rolling out lamb racks for the end of summer. Want specs?
Send specs. We might do a special.
Domestic, 1.5 lb average rack, frenched. $19 a pound.
Pass this time, too high for the margins. Check back in the fall.
Understood.
Order for tomorrow: same as standing, plus 5 lb chorizo.
Got it. See you at 8.
Who's in for the Royals game next week?
I'm in.
I can't, kid has a recital.
Off that night, I'm in. Who's driving?
I'll drive. Bring cash for parking.
Got home, shoulders killing me. Y'all ever think about doing something that doesn't involve standing for ten hours?
Dez, you love it.
He loves complaining about it more.
Both can be true 😂
Garrison court is open tomorrow morning. 9 sharp, we need ten.
I'm in. Bringing the good ball, not the one with no grip.
Dez you coming? You owe us after last time
Prep until close tonight, so I'll be dragging. But yeah, I'm in. Don't pick me last.
Pick you last? You're 6'1" and wide as a door, you go first 😂
Six five and a half if we're being honest.
Cookout at my place next month. Dez, you're bringing the meat.
I'll bring ribs. Beer's on you.
Deal.
Desmond, are you still doing the food for my party? I need to tell the hall.
Yes Auntie. Mom told me, fifty people. I'll send a menu soon.
God bless you. Not too much pepper for Uncle Emeka.
Dez, I can pick up the pans whenever.
Good. Need your truck the morning of.
Mom, stop forwarding chain messages, please.
They are important.
They are not.
Sunday dinner at my house. Jollof and fried plantain. Everybody come hungry.
I'm on shift until 7 that morning, I'll come straight after. Save me the crispy bottom of the pot.
I'll bring the folding chairs and the speaker.
Desmond, you bring Imani. And you eat something that is not standing up.
We'll be there Mom. I'll bring the suya.
My baby starts school soon?? She was just this big 🥹
Few weeks. First grade at Hawthorne. She already picked out her backpack.
Send a picture of the backpack!
Menu: jollof, fried rice, grilled chicken, moi moi, plantain, small chops. Tell me if anyone's allergic to anything.
No allergies. Add suya!
Suya added.
I'm bringing the dessert. Don't argue.
She is bringing dessert, good.
Ruiz Auto: your car is ready. Brakes done, rotors resurfaced. Total $284.
Thanks. I'll pick up after 2, got a school pickup first.
We close at 6. See you then.
Check engine light came back on.
Bring it in. Could be the O2 sensor again. We'll scan it free.
Can I come in the morning, after I drop my daughter?
Yeah 8:30 works. Leave the key in the box if we're not open.
Scanned it. Loose gas cap code plus one old sensor reading. Cleared it. Tighten the cap until it clicks.
Ha. Okay. What do I owe you?
Nothing today. Come back if it returns.
Oil change, how soon can you fit me in? Also AC's blowing warm.
Oil change is 20 minutes. AC needs a recharge, 89 plus parts if the compressor's fine.
Do both. I'll bring it first thing tomorrow.
Works. Bring it by 8.
AC is fixed. It was a slow leak at a hose fitting. Charged and sealed.
Cold air, love it. Kansas City in August would've killed me.
Total is $196. Pay whenever you swing by.
Hey, got three knives that need a full edge. Gyuto, petty, and a yanagiba. When can I drop them?
Hi Dez. Yanagiba is single bevel so I'll need it a few days. Bring all three any afternoon this week.
Cool. How much for the lot?
Gyuto 18, petty 12, yanagiba 30. Total 60.
Fair. Dropping them off tomorrow around 3.
I'll be in the shop. Wrap the blades please, last time one came loose in your bag.
Noted, sorry about that.
Ready. Yanagiba came out beautiful. Hair-popping sharp.
Perfect, grabbing them on my way to work.
Leave the 60 on the counter if I'm in back, I'll see it.
Chipped the heel of the gyuto on a bone. Can you fix it or is that a regrind?
Bring it by. Probably a small regrind, 25 bucks.
Do it. No rush.
Gyuto's done. Took a quarter inch off the heel, shape's still good.
Thanks Hollis. Picking up tomorrow.
Also, new stones came in. If you ever want to learn sharpening yourself, free lesson for regulars.

notes.title: Egusi — Mom's way
notes.body:
Mom on the phone, Sunday. Writing it down before I forget again.

- Ground egusi, 2 cups, mixed with a little water into a paste
- Palm oil, 1/2 cup. Heat it, DON'T smoke it
- 1 onion blended with 2 scotch bonnets + red bell pepper
- Fry paste in oil till it clumps, 8-10 min
- Stock, 3 cups, add beef + stockfish
- Spinach goes in last, 3 min
- Crayfish, a big spoon. Locust beans if Ada isn't coming over

Mom says: don't stir too much. Let it sit. Serve with pounded yam, Imani likes it with rice.
